commentary.text: 90+13' The match has just finished.
90+13' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) receives a yellow card.
90+13' Morato (Nottingham) is penalised.
90+12' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) swings it in and Chris Wood gets on the end of it, but Dean Henderson shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
90+11' The ball is behind the sideline. Ola Aina (Nottingham) takes a throw-in.
90+10' The foul by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) was seen by Andy Madley who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+9' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90+7' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

90+6' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
90+6' Crystal Palace force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

90+6' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Matz Sels, who tips the ball around the post.
90+1' A goal, which was scored by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace), was disallowed due to offside.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.

90' It seemed like Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates. Chris Wood (Nottingham) commits a foul and Andy Madley immediately signals a free kick.

89' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the bar. Nice run, but unlucky finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
88' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
87' Substitution. Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) has come on for Daichi Kamada.
86' The free kick from close range, taken by Crystal Palace, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) makes a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

83' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) misses a chance to score! He produces a header from inside the box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
82' Yellow card. Ola Aina (Nottingham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
82' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
81' Nuno Espirito Santo is forced to make a change. Murillo is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Morato (Nottingham).

81' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
79' Murillo (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
78' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
77' What was Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
76' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Ibrahim Sangare will be replaced by Ryan Yates (Nottingham).
76' It is time for a substitution. Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is on for Jean-Philippe Mateta.
74' Neco Williams (Nottingham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Crystal Palace.
71' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

69' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will take a throw-in.
67' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
65' Substitution. Ramon Sosa (Nottingham) replaces Nicolas Dominguez.
64' 1 - 1 Goal! Neco Williams takes aim and his effort deflects off Murillo (Nottingham) to beat the goalkeeper. 1:1.
64' Nottingham will take a corner kick.

63' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Dean Henderson thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
63' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is booked.
61' Here's the change. Adam Wharton leaves the pitch and Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) comes on as a substitute.
60' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Matz Sels no chance!
60' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
59' Matz Sels (Nottingham) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
59' It’s a PENALTY to Crystal Palace after the VAR review!
58' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) commits a rough foul. Andy Madley stops the game and makes a call.
58' Andy Madley blows his whistle. Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) commits a foul after dangerous play.
58' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Crystal Palace for a penalty. Play continues.
58' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
55' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
55' Neco Williams (Nottingham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Dean Henderson was alert and made a comfortable save.
54' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) and Ismaila Sarr attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
52' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
52' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
51' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

51' Chris Wood (Nottingham) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. Nottingham get a corner.
51' Matz Sels pulls off a great save to deny Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal.

49' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
49' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) was too forceful with his tackle and Andy Madley interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Crystal Palace are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
49' Crystal Palace seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
47' The resulting corner from Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is cleared.
47' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Morgan Gibbs-White, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but Matz Sels comes off his line to gather the ball.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Dean Henderson shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
41' Chris Wood (Nottingham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

41' Morgan Gibbs-White tees up Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
40' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Nottingham win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
39' Andy Madley blows his whistle and it's Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
39' Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
39' An indirect free kick, taken by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

37' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
35' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

35' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom right corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
32' Nottingham are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
30' Anthony Elanga received a clever long ball from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
28' Dangerous play by Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace). Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul. Nottingham are awarded a free kick.
27' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
24' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' Neco Williams (Nottingham) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
18' Ola Aina (Nottingham) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
16' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
14' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) produces a cunning chipped pass for Jean-Philippe Mateta, who takes it down well but fails to get past the defenders and loses the ball.
13' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
12' The linesman points to the corner flag, Crystal Palace are going to take it.

12' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound outside the box and doesn't hesitate to shoot on goal. It was a promising attempt, but one of the defending players got in the way and blocked it.
10' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) sends a long cross over to Eberechi Eze, but Matz Sels comes forward to gather the ball.
10' Daniel Munoz receives a short pass from Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort. It's a throw-in for Crystal Palace.
7' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nottingham comes to nothing.
7' Chris Wood (Nottingham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.

5' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
5' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
4' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
3' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
2' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a throw-in.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Nottingham will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Andy Madley.
